mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) at or below 0.2% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns through lower cost of capital for corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 8.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger recessionary fears, causing negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns through reduced consumer spending and corporate profit expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.5.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly rising housing starts (HOUST > 470) and industrial production (INDPRO > 90) signal synchronized demand and supply expansion, generating positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns through sustained corporate revenue growth and margin stability.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when both HOUST > 470 and INDPRO > 90.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, housing starts (HOUST > 480) indicate sustained consumer demand strength, producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns through elevated retail sales and corporate capital expenditure.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when HOUST > 480 during late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 225 indicates accelerating inflation that triggers monetary tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns through rising real interest rates and equity valuation compression.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 225.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 130000) and low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.15) signal favorable labor market conditions and accommodative monetary policy, generating positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns through sustained corporate hiring and consumer spending.
regime_hint: labor market strength with monetary easing
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when both PAYEMS > 130000 and FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.15.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) above 90 indicates robust manufacturing output growth, generating positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns through sustained corporate production capacity and profit margins.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO > 90.

mechanism_narrative: In demand expansion regimes, retail sales (RSAFS > 380000) signal strong consumer spending momentum, producing positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns through elevated corporate revenue growth and sustained earnings expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when RSAFS > 380000 during demand expansion.
